text.style: font-size: 9.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4b5563

g.text: Notes: Error bars are 95% paired bootstrap intervals (10,000 resamples). Terra cost in panel A is the judged run; its three-run mean saving was 53.95% (SD 0.29 pp). Luna failed the 100% structural-validity requirement.

text.style: font-size: 9.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4b5563

g.text: Cost uses provider-reported tokens and the frozen 2026-09-14 price snapshot. Main-chat responses were not rerouted. Judge: gpt-4o-2024-11-20, blinded A/B/C ordering.
